undo.note: cancellable for 14 days after the request; irreversible once the deletion runs

en: How do I cancel a store deletion?

steps: Open Settings, press Delete this store
Read the checks; if one blocks you, fix it and try again
Type the store address exactly and press Schedule deletion
The store is deleted after 14 days unless you press Cancel the deletion
edgeCases: Owner only: staff and store admins who are not the owner get 403; another store answers 404
Refused with a named reason while money is in flight, the store subscription is billed, or it is the billing (main) store and the owner has other stores
The same checks run again when the 14 days end; a store that became blocked stays scheduled and keeps its reason
The confirmation token is single use and bound to this store and this owner; a wrong typed address does not spend it
On a Durable-Object store the money check happens when the deletion runs, not when it is scheduled
Orders keep the tax and payment records the law requires without the customer's identity
Platform staff (super_admin) can still delete a support or test store immediately: DELETE /stores/:id has no cooling-off
gaps: An assistant must never run this from chat: it deep-links to Settings and explains the consequences
